title: Avali's Stuff
description: A mod that wants to add avali to your amazing world!
body:
# Avali's Stuff

The Avali's Stuff mod brings unique and fun content to Minecraft inspired by the Avali universe! Expect not only fun additions like nuggets and Avali chicken, but also many other surprises that will make your game even more fun. Stay tuned for more exciting content to come!


_Look at theese cute Avali chikens on hill)_
![Cutie Avali Chickens on the hill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d6c9f72fb7453b943e0ae4c7c998912cdcd918a.png)

## What's next?
- Aerogel
- Items based on aerogel and such more :)
